watch.text: Clemson lost QB Tait Reynolds for the season and backup Christopher Vizzina was hurt; it beat Duke 20-10 Friday with a Pearman/Denson QB rotation.
QB LaNorris Sellers (ankle) missed the 34-6 Arkansas loss; he was left off every SEC report this week and is expected to play vs Georgia tonight.
WR Mazeo Bennett Jr., DB Judge Collier and edge Anthony Addison were downgraded to out for Georgia on Friday; WR Nyck Harbor is available.
QB Billy Edwards Jr. (upper body, hurt Nov. 14 vs Louisville) did not start at Virginia; freshman Travis Burgess made his first start in a 41-24 loss on Nov. 21.
QB Aidan Chiles (upper body) is out vs Minnesota, his third straight missed game; our ratings still lean on games he started.
QB Julian Sayin has been out since the Oct. 17 Indiana game with freshman Luke Fahey starting; much of Ohio State's rating comes from Sayin's starts.
Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska on Nov. 21 with Luke Fahey at QB, its 4th loss; our ratings run through Week 11 and do not include it yet.
QB Katin Houser is not likely to play vs Iowa after broken-nose surgery; Michael Clayton II starts. The line moved from Iowa -6.5 to -9.5.
QB AJ Swann was hurt again at Auburn and is out vs Tennessee Tech; Mississippi State is down to its third-string QB.
RB Fluff Bothwell was out vs Tennessee Tech on Nov. 21 and star WR Anthony Evans III left that game hurt.
QB Avery Johnson has been out since October (neck/shoulder); Dillon Duff is likely to start vs Arizona after starting the TCU loss.
WR Mike Matthews (knee) and OL Nic Moore are out for the season, the 11th Vol lost this year; QB George MacIntyre is expected to play vs LSU.
Edge Rylan Kennedy is reported out for the season and FSU has 23 players ruled out vs NC State; RB Amari Thomas is also out for the year.
Star edge Colin Simmons was ruled out vs Arkansas (Nov. 21) and DB Kobe Black left that game with what looked like a significant injury.
DT Hero Kanu is out for the season after surgery for a torn biceps.
Michigan ruled out 3 offensive linemen for UCLA and WR JJ Buchanan is likely out for the season.
Michigan was expected to start QB Bryce Underwood vs UCLA, per ESPN sources, with WR Andrew Marsh suspended; Underwood had been benched for Tommy Carr earlier.
QB Drew Mestemaker (right shoulder stinger) is questionable at Arizona State tonight; Eric Morris expected him to be OK. Final status 90 minutes before kickoff.
QB Malik Washington (knee) did not start vs Wisconsin; transfer Cardell Williams started. Maryland plays at USC.
Nebraska beat Ohio State 31-28 on Nov. 21 despite several defensive starters being out; that result is not in our Week 11 ratings yet.
Defensive starter Francis Brewu is off the injury report and returns for SMU.
QB Jaden Craig is doubtful vs Utah; backup Adam Schobel is expected to make his first career start. Ratings were built with Craig.
RB Dierre Hill Jr. left the Nov. 20 Michigan State win with a lower-body injury and was in a walking boot afterward; status for Washington unknown.
QB Keelon Russell sat out the Nov. 21 Chattanooga game with a nagging injury and Austin Mack started; his status for Auburn is not yet known.
QB Jared Curtis re-aggravated an old wrist injury late in the Nov. 21 Florida loss and returned; Clark Lea does not expect a long-term problem.
QB Steve Angeli left the 27-15 loss at Boston College on Nov. 21 in the 3rd quarter with his right arm in a sling; Malachi Nelson finished. No timeline yet.
QB Braden Atkinson (right hand) is out vs Utah State, his second straight missed game; Maalik Murphy started vs Boise State and is the likely starter.
Florida beat Vanderbilt on Nov. 21 (Vanderbilt trailed 34-27 late); that result is not in our Week 11 ratings yet.

401858537.summary: Both QBs are hurt (Chiles and Houser), which explains some of the gap but not 8 points; both teams played Saturday and those results are not in our ratings yet.

reasons.text: QB Aidan Chiles (upper body) is ruled out vs Minnesota, his third straight missed game.
QB Katin Houser is not likely to play vs Iowa after surgery on a broken nose, Bret Bielema said Tuesday; Michael Clayton II has started in his absence.

swings.Illinois: QB Katin Houser is not likely to play vs Iowa after broken-nose surgery (Nov 17); the market marked Illinois down, our ratings haven't yet.
swings.Northwestern: QB Aidan Chiles has missed three straight games (Nov 19); the market rates Northwestern without him, our ratings still carry his starts.

401856765.summary: Tennessee's 11 season-ending injuries are real but small next to a 13-point gap; Vanderbilt QB Jared Curtis's wrist is not expected to be a long-term issue.

reasons.text: WR Mike Matthews (knee) and OL Nic Moore are out for the season; Moore is the 11th Vol lost for the year.
QB Jared Curtis re-aggravated an old wrist injury late in the Florida loss and returned; Clark Lea expects him to practice this week.

swings.Tennessee: Nothing found: the market moved on Tennessee without a clear reason beyond its 11 season-ending injuries (OL Nic Moore the latest, Nov 19).
swings.Vanderbilt: Vanderbilt lost to Florida on Nov. 21 and QB Jared Curtis hurt his wrist late (not expected to be long-term); nothing else found to explain the move.

401858313.summary: UNC freshman Travis Burgess started for an injured Billy Edwards Jr. and UNC lost 41-24 at Virginia; that covers part of an 11.6-point gap.

reasons.text: QB Billy Edwards Jr. (upper body) was a game-time decision and did not start at Virginia; Travis Burgess made his first start in a 41-24 loss.
WR Keenan Jackson, Will Wilson and Chase Bond are out vs Florida State; Popo Aguirre is probable.

swings.NC State: NC State has WRs Keenan Jackson, Will Wilson and Chase Bond out vs FSU (Nov 20), but nothing found that fully explains the move.
swings.North Carolina: QB Billy Edwards Jr. did not start and UNC lost 41-24 at Virginia with Travis Burgess (Nov. 21); the market prices his absence and that loss, our ratings don't yet.

401858540.summary: Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska on Saturday with QB Julian Sayin still out; our ratings do not include that loss yet, which covers part of the gap.

reasons.text: QB Julian Sayin (throwing arm, hurt Oct. 17 at Indiana) remains sidelined; freshman Luke Fahey has started. Ryan Day gave an encouraging Sayin update this week; no return date.
Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska on Nov. 21 with Luke Fahey at QB, its 4th loss of the season.
Michigan was expected to start QB Bryce Underwood vs UCLA with WR Andrew Marsh suspended, per ESPN; Michigan had also ruled out 3 offensive linemen.

swings.Ohio State: Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska on Nov. 21 with QB Julian Sayin still out (Eleven Warriors); the market marked the Buckeyes down, our Week 11 ratings have not.

401856873.summary: Nothing in the news explains it; both teams play tonight (Arizona at Kansas State, Arizona State vs Oklahoma State) and the market rates Arizona State closer than we do.

swings.Arizona State: Nothing found: the market moved on Arizona State without a clear reason.
swings.Arizona: Nothing found: the market moved on Arizona without a clear reason.

401856764.summary: Clemson beat Duke 20-10 with a QB rotation and South Carolina lost 34-6 without Sellers, which explains part of it; Sellers is expected back vs Georgia tonight.

reasons.text: QB LaNorris Sellers (ankle) sat vs Arkansas but was left off every SEC report this week and is expected to play vs Georgia.
QB Tait Reynolds (knee surgery) is out for the season and backup Christopher Vizzina was also hurt vs Georgia Tech. Clemson is turning to its third-string QB for Duke.

swings.Clemson: Clemson lost QB Tait Reynolds for the season and backup Vizzina was hurt (Nov 17); it still beat Duke 20-10 Friday with a QB rotation, and the market stayed on Clemson.

401856759.summary: FSU's growing injury list (edge Rylan Kennedy and RB Amari Thomas out for the season) and Florida's win over Vanderbilt on Saturday explain part of the gap.

reasons.text: Starting edge Rylan Kennedy is reported out for the season; FSU downgraded two more starters and has 23 players ruled out vs NC State.
Starting RB Amari Thomas is expected to miss the rest of the season after being hurt vs Pittsburgh.
Florida beat Vanderbilt on Nov. 21 (Vanderbilt trailed 34-27 late); our ratings run through Week 11.

401858543.summary: Nothing found in the news; UCLA entered its Michigan game 10-0 and the market still rates USC closer than we do. We couldn't confirm why the line moved from USC -10.5.

reasons.text: DraftKings listed USC -10.5 on Nov. 16; the SP+ projection is UCLA by 6.8, close to our line.

401856761.summary: Nothing in the news explains it; both teams play tonight (Kentucky at Missouri, Louisville vs Pittsburgh), and WR Nic Anderson was trending toward playing for Kentucky.

reasons.text: WR Nic Anderson (questionable) is trending toward playing vs Missouri; Jahlil Florence is also questionable.

swings.SMU: SMU shifted defensive starters after its loss to Wake Forest and injuries (On3, Nov 20); Notre Dame also gets Francis Brewu back.

swings.TCU: TCU QB Jaden Craig is doubtful vs Utah and backup Adam Schobel is expected to make his first career start (Nov 21).

401860919.summary: Oregon State is without QB Braden Atkinson again, which explains part of the gap; the line has moved from Oregon State -8.5 to -7.

reasons.text: QB Braden Atkinson (right hand) is out vs Utah State; Maalik Murphy, who threw for 396 yards vs Boise State, is the likely starter.

swings.Auburn: No Auburn news found; the likely driver is Alabama QB Keelon Russell sitting out the Nov. 21 Chattanooga game with Austin Mack starting.

swings.Mississippi State: QB AJ Swann is out (Clarion-Ledger, Nov. 19), RB Fluff Bothwell missed the Nov. 21 game and WR Anthony Evans III left it hurt.
swings.Ole Miss: Nothing found: the market moved on Ole Miss without a clear reason; its last game was against FCS Wofford.
